title: ToroSwap
tagline: ToroSwap is the best way for creators and influencers to get paid
description:
ToroSwap is Patreon meets DeFi. Let your true fans support your creative work.

Tap in to the power of digital assets and effortlessly create, sell, exchange NFTs. Keep with your fans engaged with exclusive virtual collectibles and perks.

Top creators, artists, musicians, influencers across the world use ToroSwap to turn followers into true fans. Create a modern merch store filled with exclusive digital collectibles and perks you define. Each purchase is backed by NFTs (non-fungible tokens) that represent your work and will be forever minted in the blockchain of choice.
how_its_made: ToroSwap uses React, Golang, Postgres, and GCP. It leverages MetaMask for authentication, Coinbase Commerce for payments, IPFS for storage.
